name: Arkansas Metal Products
old_description: Call Arkansas Metal Products today for superior metal products customized to your exact specifications and requirements at a competitive cost.
about:
Arkansas Metal Products operates from Bald Knob, Arkansas, where it has built over 40 years of experience in custom metal fabrication. The company is veteran-owned and family-operated, though the founding year and original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including plasma profiling, laser profiling, welding, tube and bar processing, forming, drilling, and crane and hoist operations. Design work is handled in-house using AutoCAD, SigmaNEST, SketchUp, and SolidWorks. The facility also runs a custom coating line under the AMP Custom Coating brand, adding protective finishes to fabricated parts. Headcount, facility size, and annual volume figures are not published.

The company serves both industrial clients needing custom fabrication and retail customers through its AMP Outdoor Outfitters line, which targets hunters and outdoor enthusiasts. Specific industry sectors beyond outdoor recreation are not listed.

Arkansas Metal Products emphasizes a lean-minded, skilled fabricator team and a quality management system focused on the processes that achieve consistent results. The company states that every project begins only after a clear understanding of customer specifications, aiming to surpass expectations for craftsmanship and service.
